subject: Re: Riverbend - request for extended ephemeral log retention
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@riverbendhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Riverbend Health Security <security@riverbendhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended ephemeral log retention for audit and forensics

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We kicked the integration to prod over the weekend and are in the middle of a SOC-2 readiness run with our internal auditors. A question came up from our compliance team: Riverbend needs to retain a richer set of request/response log metadata for 180 days (currently your default ephemeral logs are 30 days) to support forensics and certain eDiscovery scopes tied to our contracts with payors.

We understand Redwood's default position on ephemeral logs and minimizing PII surface, but given the regulatory and contractual risk here, we're asking whether Redwood can provide: 
- A customer-scoped retention variance to hold anonymized request metadata and service-level telemetry (no customer content) for 180 days
- A comfort note describing controls around access, encryption-at-rest, and deletion procedures

Can you share what evidence and agreements you'll need from us, and whether this is something Redwood can support for an enterprise contract? We attached a CSV with a mapping of the Riverbend audit buckets and sample retention fields.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of feasibility — our audit window starts 2026-09-02.

—Asha
Asha Patel
Director, Security & Compliance | Riverbend Health
asha.patel@riverbendhealth.com
(415) 555-0187

Attachments: riverbend_evidence_matrix.xlsx (CSV-style mapping)
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@riverbendhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extended ephemeral log retention for audit and forensics

Thanks Asha — appreciate the context and the file. Short answer: we can explore a scoped variance, but we need to confirm a few technical and legal guardrails first so we don't create an undue risk to other customers or the platform. Some points up front: 

1) Scope: please confirm the exact fields you need to retain (we saw the spreadsheet but want the final column list). We need to ensure no full prompt/response content is retained unless you explicitly want content retained under a separate agreement.

2) Anonymization: Redwood typically retains only hashed identifiers for 30 days; we can create an anonymized request metadata bucket (no PII, salted hashes) with stricter access controls. Is that acceptable to Riverbend?

3) Access & controls: we'll require that Riverbend sign a small MOU to lock down access, require MFA + SCIM group mapping, and agree to sampling-based audits. Karthik (legal/security) — can you confirm what evidence we should provide (SOC-2 mapping, KMS key policy excerpt, access log sample)?

4) Timeline: can you accept a staged approach — 90 days while legal/engineering complete controls, then extend to 180 days on DocuSign? Your audit start date is tight but we can prioritize the control package.

I'll loop in Ben from Sales to capture billing/contract implications.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@riverbendhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extended ephemeral log retention for audit and forensics

Mina / Ben — I reviewed the ask and Riverbend's spreadsheet. We're comfortable moving forward with a customer-scoped retention variance subject to the following conditions: 

- Data types allowed: hashed request identifiers, request headers (redacted authorization headers), non-content telemetry (latency, token counts, model id), and routing metadata. No prompt/response content or verbatim outputs may be retained without explicit customer confirmation and an additional review.

- Encryption & KMS: the retention bucket must be encrypted with a customer-managed key (CMK) in KMS. If Riverbend cannot provide a CMK, Redwood will use a dedicated key with strict key policy that limits decryption to a named Redwood SRE role. Provide KMS ARN or accept dedicated-key terms.

- Access controls: SCIM-based group mapping, mandatory MFA (hardware preferred), and quarterly access reviews. All access must be logged and tied to an internal ticket.

- Audit evidence: we'll provide a redacted sample of the retention store (one-week window), an excerpt of the retention deletion job (cron + retention policy), and a SOC-2 control mapping that references the variance. We will not provide raw PII.

- Legal: Riverbend must sign a short MOU amending the data retention schedule in the Master Services Agreement; MOU will include a liability cap aligned to the Enterprise SKU. Ben, please add pricing/legal routing.

If Riverbend accepts the above, engineering will create a separate, customer-scoped retention table in our telemetry tier and apply the 180d TTL. Estimated engineering lead time: 7–10 business days after approvals and CMK provisioning.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

Hi Asha — following up with next steps and attachments. Great to hear the staged approach works for you. Summary and action items: 

1) We will provision a customer-scoped retention bucket with anonymized request metadata and a 90-day trial TTL by 2026-08-25. After legal signs the MOU, we will flip the TTL to 180 days.

2) KMS: please let us know if you will provide a customer-managed key ARN by EOD 2026-08-20. If not, we'll provision a dedicated Redwood key and share the key policy excerpt.

3) Evidence pack: attached is a draft MOU (retention_variance_mou_draft.docx) and an evidence checklist (riverbend_evidence_matrix.xlsx) with the fields we'll deliver. Karthik will prepare the redacted sample retention export once the bucket exists.

4) Pricing note: the extended retention will incur an incremental monthly telemetry storage fee. I'll create a HubSpot quote and attach it to the MOU.

Please reply-all with acceptance on the technical controls and confirm CMK plan. Once accepted, legal will route MOU for signature (DocuSign link will follow).

Thanks — Ben
